### Listen to Your Heart, Not Your Head
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-10-2018.html
Passage: Matthew 25:40
Points:
- Overcoming personal excuses and fear of awkwardness is essential to helping vulnerable people.
- Christ explained that showing compassion to the needy is equivalent to serving Him directly.
- Societal mindsets often dismiss struggling or marginalized individuals as unworthy of attention.
- Stepping out of our personal comfort zones allows us to act as Christ's hands and feet.
- Answering God's nudge to show mercy brings lasting spiritual joy and eternal value.

### Finding Your Calcutta
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-oct-24-2008-11583348.html
Passage: Matthew 25:40
Points:
- Caring for the least of these includes reaching people overlooked or rejected by society.
- Poverty is spiritual as well as physical, often masked by material wealth and busyness.
- Christians do not have to travel overseas to find the hurting and brokenhearted.
- A believer's specific ministry calling often emerges through personal crises and heartaches.
- Faith is lived out by recognizing and serving the spiritually or physically poor around us.

### A Prayer to Be the Hands and Feet of Christ
Author: Brian Kolodiejchuk
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-be-the-hands-and-feed-of-christ-your-daily-prayer-may-1-2017.html
Passage: Matthew 25:40
Points:
- True ministry to the vulnerable flows from a life fully surrendered to Jesus.
- Believers are called to let Christ shine through them so others encounter His love.
- Demonstrating genuine compassion often speaks much louder than spoken words alone.
- Followers of Christ must ask God for eyes unclouded by judgment or prejudice.
- Stepping into places of human need fulfills Christ’s call to serve Him in others.
